hotels.name: Ndlovu Addo River Lodge
hotels.description_fr:
Proposant une piscine, un jardin, une terrasse et connexion Wi-Fi gratuite, l’établissement Ndlovu Addo River Lodge se situe à Kirkwood et offre une vue sur le cours d’eau.

Vous bénéficierez d’une salle de bains privative entièrement équipée avec une douche et un sèche-cheveux.

Vous pourrez profiter d’un barbecue sur place et pratiquer la pêche et le canoë-kayak à proximité.

L'aéroport le plus proche (Aéroport international Chief Dawid Stuurman) est à 82 km.

Les couples apprécient particulièrement l'emplacement de cet établissement. Ils lui donnent la note de 9,2 pour un séjour à deux.

hotels.description_en:
Elegant Accommodation: Ndlovu Addo River Lodge in Kirkwood offers a lodge experience with a sun terrace, garden, and a year-round outdoor swimming pool. Guests enjoy free WiFi throughout the property.
Comfortable Amenities: The lodge features private check-in and check-out services, an outdoor fireplace, daily housekeeping, outdoor seating, picnic areas, full-day security, and barbecue facilities. Free on-site private parking is available.
Scenic Views: Guests can relax on the terrace, balcony, or patio with lake, garden, or river views. The property includes a private bathroom, dining area, and amenities such as air-conditioning, hot tub, kitchenette, and TV.
Activities and Location: The lodge offers fishing and canoeing activities.

Ndlovu Addo River Lodge está en Kirkwood y ofrece vistas al río, piscina al aire libre, jardín, terraza y zona de barbacoa. El lodge ofrece wifi y parking privado, ambos gratis.

Todas las unidades tienen baño privado totalmente equipado con ducha y secador de pelo.

Se puede practicar pesca y piragüismo en los alrededores.

hotels.name: Africanos Country Estate
hotels.description_fr:
Africanos Country Estate is located in Addo, within 15 km from the popular Addo Elephant National Park. The country house features an outdoor swimming pool, restaurant and terrace. The onsite restaurant boasts a sushi bar.
The modern rooms come fitted with air conditioning, a sofa and flat-screen satellite TV. Extras featured in the rooms include a laptop safe, desk and tea-and-coffee-making facilities. The private bathrooms come with a bath and shower.
At Africanos Country Estate the restaurant offers an à la carte menu and breakfast is served daily. Other facilities include a children’s playground, and free WiFi is available in all areas.
Nanaga Farmstall is 30 km from the property.

hotels.name: Little Stream Farm
hotels.description_fr:
Offrant une vue sur le lac, l’hébergement Little Stream Farm se trouve au Cap, à respectivement 35 km et 36 km de ces lieux d’intérêt : Ferry de Robben Island et Front de mer Victoria et Alfred. Cet hébergement avec climatisation est installé à 33 km de : Palais des congrès CTICC. Vous pourrez profiter d’une connexion Wi-Fi gratuite et d’un parking privé disponible sur place.

Disposant d’un patio et offrant une vue sur la montagne, cette maison de vacances comprend 2 chambres, un salon, une télévision à écran plat, une kitchenette équipée avec un réfrigérateur et un lave-vaisselle, ainsi que 2 salles de bains avec une douche. Des serviettes et du linge de lit sont disponibles.

Vous pourrez profiter d’un jardin sur place et pratiquer la pêche ainsi que le canoë-kayak dans les environs.
hotels.description_en:
Spacious Holiday Home in Cape Town: Little Stream Farm offers a spacious holiday home in Cape Town. The property features two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a living room, and a fully equipped kitchen.
Outdoor Amenities: Guests can enjoy a beautiful garden and free WiFi. The property includes a picnic area, family rooms, and a patio with lake and mountain views.
Convenient Facilities: The holiday home provides free on-site private parking, air-conditioning, a washing machine, and a fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances.
Local Attractions: Located 38 km from Cape Town International Airport, Little Stream Farm is close to attractions such as CTICC (33 km), Robben Island Ferry (35 km), and Table Mountain (41 km).
hotels.description_es:
Little Stream Farm es un alojamiento con vistas al lago que se encuentra en Ciudad del Cabo, a 35 km de Ferri de Robben Island y a 36 km de Victoria & Alfred Waterfront. Este alojamiento con aire acondicionado está a 33 km de Centro Internacional de Convenciones de Ciudad del Cabo CTICC y ofrece wifi gratis y parking privado en el propio alojamiento.

La casa o chalet cuenta con patio y vistas a la montaña, y dispone de 2 dormitorios, una sala de estar, TV de pantalla plana, una zona de cocina equipada con nevera y lavavajillas, y 2 baños con ducha. Hay toallas y ropa de cama en la casa o chalet.

Hay jardín en este alojamiento, y en la zona se puede practicar pesca y piragüismo.

Jardín Botánico Nacional Kirstenbosch está a 40 km del alojamiento, y Montaña de la Mesa está a 41 km.
hotels.description_pt:
Oferecendo vista do lago, Little Stream Farm localiza-se na Cidade do Cabo, a 35 km de Ferry Robben Island e 36 km de Passeio Marítimo V&A. O alojamento com ar condicionado está a 33 km de CTICC, e os hóspedes beneficiam de estacionamento privado disponível no local e acesso Wi-Fi gratuito.

Esta casa de férias com um pátio e vista da montanha apresenta 2 quartos, uma sala de estar, uma televisão de ecrã plano, uma kitchenette equipada com frigorífico e máquina de lavar louça, e 2 casas de banho com chuveiro. Toalhas e roupa de cama são providenciadas nesta casa de férias.

Os hóspedes de Little Stream Farm podem praticar pesca e canoagem nas proximidades, ou aproveitar ao máximo o jardim.
hotels.description_it:
Dotato di vista sul lago, Little Stream Farm è un alloggio situato a Città del Capo, a 35 km da Traghetto per Robben Island e 36 km da Victoria & Alfred Waterfront. Con aria condizionata, l’alloggio dista 33 km da Cape Town International Convention Centre e offre il WiFi gratuito e il parcheggio privato disponibile sul posto.

Questa casa vacanze con patio e vista sulla montagna presenta 2 camere da letto, un soggiorno, una TV a schermo piatto, un angolo cottura con frigorifero e lavastoviglie e 2 bagni con doccia. Presso questa casa vacanze troverete asciugamani e lenzuola in dotazione.

Durante il vostro soggiorno presso questa casa vacanze, potrete praticare la pesca e il canottaggio nelle vicinanze o usufruire del giardino.
